# outbox CLI reference

> Every `outbox` subcommand with its flags and defaults, generated from the argparse parser in `src/outbox/cli.py`.

Run each as `outbox <command>` (the installed script) or `python3 -m outbox.cli <command>`; `--help` on any of them prints the same flags.

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`init`](#outbox-init) | Create mailbox dirs and drop task_open. |
| [`run`](#outbox-run) | Run three policy bots on a task. |
| [`watch`](#outbox-watch) | Pretty-print a ledger.jsonl. |
| [`score`](#outbox-score) | Score a finished arena directory. |
| [`suite`](#outbox-suite) | Run every task in a directory. |
| [`relay`](#outbox-relay) | Deliver any undelivered outbox files. |

## `outbox init`

Create mailbox dirs and drop task_open.

| Flag | Required | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--task TASK` | yes | — |
| `--arena ARENA` | yes | — |
